name: FASER2
summary: FASER2 is proposed for CERN's Forward Physics Facility west of ATLAS. It is retained as a separately named successor; FPF is the facility framework, rather than an additional dark-matter detector.
detection_principle: A larger far-forward decay volume and magnetic-spectrometer acceptance search for long-lived weakly coupled particles produced at the LHC and visibly decaying after traversing rock.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
